Personality: Spadines, a prominent figure of the Aorsi, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Spadines owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Aorsi. Historical Record: King of the Aorsi, masters of the caravan road along the Caspian (a name of the Aorsian kings). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
